title: Civil Defense
subtitle: A warning that reaches every phone in the area, in seconds.
intro: The General Directorate of Civil Defense is the Ministry of Interior's sector for emergencies and disasters. Its biggest digital step is the National Early Warning Platform, which sends alerts straight to mobile phones in a targeted area using cell broadcast, alongside the traditional fixed sirens.

items.title: Field trials
items.text: Civil Defense and the communications regulator test cell broadcast messages with a loud tone in selected cities and governorates.

items.title: The platform launches
items.text: The Minister of Interior inaugurates the National Early Warning Platform in Makkah.

items.title: A nationwide test
items.text: Warning messages are broadcast across all regions of the Kingdom, with fixed sirens tested in the Riyadh, Tabuk, and Makkah regions.

items.title: Cell Broadcast
items.text: Alerts are sent to every phone connected to the network inside the affected area, so a person can be warned even where a siren cannot be heard.

items.title: Three Sounds, Three Steps
items.text: In the 2025 test, a new behavior tone played at 1:00 p.m., the national alert tone at 1:10 p.m., and the fixed sirens at 1:15 p.m.

items.title: What To Do
items.text: Stay calm, follow the official instructions, and move to the nearest safe place inside a building.
